review:
Retro Hot Slot reels with the Hold the Jackpot bonus bolted on. The base game is simple sevens-and-fruit play, and the bonus is where the jackpots live, topping out at a 1,500x Grand.

Cash Infinity symbols stick and make the bonus easier to reach, and Wazdan says each one pays a cash prize whenever the round is activated, so landing them never feels wasted. Chance Level lets you raise your bet for better bonus odds. High volatility, 96.14% RTP. A straightforward choice for players who like old-school reels but get bored without a bonus to aim for.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
